actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The goblin makes two attacks, using Scim- itar or Shortbow in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

actions.name: Hit
actions.text: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage. Bonus Actions

actions.name: Nimble Escape
actions.text: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Redirect Attack
reactions.text: Trigger: A creature the goblin can see makes an attack roll against it. Response: The goblin chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of itself. The goblin and that ally swap places, and the ally be- comes the target of the attack instead. Gold Dragons Gold Dragon Wyrmling
